description: This file defines the UrlSigner class responsible for creating signed URLs for Amazon CloudFront resources. It includes methods for constructing signed URLs, handling different protocols like HTTP, HTTPS, and RTMP, and managing URL signing policies.

classes.name: UrlSigner
classes.description: Class for generating signed URLs for Amazon CloudFront resources, supporting various URL schemes and policies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UrlSigner with a key pair ID and private key for signing URLs.

methods.name: getSignedUrl
methods.description: Generates a signed URL for CloudFront, optionally with expiration or custom policy.

methods.name: createRtmpUrl
methods.description: Constructs a relative RTMP URL, including query parameters if present.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates a resource string based on URL scheme, handling http, https, and rtmp protocols.
